title: Aftercare After SMP Treatment – Day-by-Day Guide

hero.heading: Aftercare After SMP Treatment – Day-by-Day Guide
hero.subtitle: Why is aftercare important?
bullets: Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) creates the appearance of dense and natural hair – but only if properly cared for after the treatment.
This page provides clear and simple instructions on how to achieve the best result and ensure the pigment remains stable for years.

sections.title: Day-by-Day Guide
bullets: If sweating occurs – gently dab with a clean paper towel
When outdoors: wear a hat or cap
Do not touch the treated area with your hands
Do not use creams/lotions on the same day

sections.title: Days 2–4
bullets: Pat dry only, do not rub
Apply a gentle, alcohol-free moisturizer if needed
Do not use a razor, clipper, or trimmer
Avoid exercise, sauna, or tanning beds
Do not use hair styling products

sections.title: Days 5–7
bullets: Wash the scalp with lukewarm, gentle water (do not rub)
Sunbathing and swimming in the sea

sections.title: After 7 Days
bullets: Use SPF 50 cream whenever outdoors for more than 10 minutes
text: Regular trimming routine (if you keep a very short style):

sections.title: What to Avoid for the Next 4 Weeks
bullets: Minoxidil (pause at least 7 days after each session)
text: If anything unexpected occurs (itching, redness, sensitivity) – contact us immediately.

sections.title: Recommended Products (As Advised)
text: You will receive detailed product recommendations during your consultation.

list.a: Visually – 2–5 days. Fully – 7–10 days. During this period, the pigment stabilizes in the skin.

list.q: Can I wash my head daily after the first week?
list.a: Yes, but use gentle products. Do not rub – just rinse and pat dry.

list.q: Can the pigment fade if I’m not careful?
list.a: Fading, smudging, or uneven tone may occur. That’s why aftercare is essential.
Do not scratch! Gently tap with a dry paper towel. Itching is a sign of healing.
